spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (खाडयति) also (इ,) खडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (खण्डति खण्डयति) and (इ ङ) खडिङ् r. 1st cl. (खण्डते)
To divide, to tear, to break off a part or piece.

m. (-डः)
1 Breaking, dividing.
2 Buttermilk boiled with acid vegetables and spices.
3 A small grass.
f. (-डी)
Chalk.
E.
खड to break, &c. affix अच्.

f. (-का)
A private or back door, a small or venetian door or window.

f. (-का)
Chalk.
E.
खड to break, affix वुन् fem. form.

m. (-डुः)
A bier.
E.
खड to break, affix उ.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A rhinoceros.
2 A rhinoceros horn.
3 A sword, a scimitar.
4 A large sacrificial knife.
5 One of the Buddhas or Bauddha saints.
n. (-ङ्गं)
Iron.
E.
खड to tear or rend, Uṇādi affix गन.

m. (-षः)
1 A creeping plant, (Scirpus maximus.)
2 A scabbard, a sheathe.
E.
खङ्ग a sword, and कोष a sheathe.

m. (-रः)
A soldier armed with a sword and shield.
E.
खड्ग, and चर्म्म a shield, धर who bears.

m. (-टः)
A large kind of Kās, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
E.
खड्ग the rhinoceros, and अट who goes; these animals being usually found amongst high grass or reeds.

m. (-रः)
A swordsman.
E.
खड्ग, and धर who holds.

m. (-रः)
A sheathe, a scabbard.
E.
खड्ग, and आधार what receives.

f. (-नुः)
1 A small knife.
2 A female rhinoceros.
E.
खड्ग a sword, &c. धेनु a cow, used here as a diminutive.

m. (-त्रः)
The name of a creeper, (Scirpus maximus.)
n. (-त्रं)
The blade of a sword.
E.
खड्ग a sword, and पत्र a leaf.

n. (-त्रं)
A vessel of buffalo's horn.
E.
खड्ग, and पात्र a vessel.

mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि)
Holding a sword.
E.
खड्ग, and पाणि the hand.

n. (-नं)
A scabbard, a sheathe.
E.
खड्ग a sword, and पिधान a sheathe; also with कन् added, खड्गपिधानक.

f. (-का)
A knife, a small sword.
E.
खड्ग, and पुत्त्रिका infant.

m. (-रः)
A sword cut.
E.
खड्ग, and प्रहार a stroke.

m. (-सः)
Buffalo-beef.
E.
खड्ग, and मांस flesh.

f. (-खा)
A row of sabres.
E.
खड्ग, and लेखा a line.

m. (-टः)
1 A shield.
2 One who observes a peculiar religious obligation, rubbing the feet backwards and forwards on the edge of a sword made red hot, this is a penance peculiar to the Bauddhas.
E.
खड्ग a sword, रट to speak, deriv. irr.

m. (-तः)
A sword cut.
E.
खड्ग, and आघात a blow.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cut or struck with a sword.
E.
खड्ग, and अभिहत struck.

n. (-षं)
Buffalo's flesh.
E.
खड्ग, and आमिष flesh.

m. (-कः)
1 The cream or froth of buffalo's milk.
2 A vender of flesh meat.
E.
खड्ग a sword, &c. affix ठक्.

m. (-कः)
A sickle, a scythe.
E.
खड्ग a scymitar, and ईकन् aff.

mfn. (-ड्गी-ड्गिनी-ड्गि)
Armed with a sword.
m. (-ड्गी)
1 A rhinoceros.
2 A Jina or Jaina saint.
E.
खड्ग a horn, &c. affix इनि.

m. (-रः)
A kind of creeper: see खड्गकोष.
E.
खड्गि a rhinoceros, and मार what destroys.
